en.summary: Fixes multiple coupled L2 scheduler and MSHR control bugs so miss lookups only launch when downstream bookkeeping can accept them, fresh allocations create request-queue entries, and pending MSHRs reschedule only after explicit cancel events.
why_it_counts: All touched files are core L2 DUT modules and every code change affects cache control behavior.
The patch repairs miss admission, miss bookkeeping, and replay predicates rather than formatting or tooling.
The changed predicates can otherwise drop miss state, over-issue directory work, or replay requests incorrectly.
disqualifiers: The commit message is generic and also mentions syntax, so the intent is less explicit than other items.
evidence: Scheduler.scala changes requests.io.push.valid from merge_subentry to merge_subentry || alloc, so newly allocated misses also enter the request structure.
Scheduler.scala tightens directory.io.read.valid with mshr_free, requests.io.push.ready, directory.io.ready, and mshr_stalls guards instead of launching every non-Hint request immediately.
MSHR.scala changes sche_a_valid re-arming from !pending_reg to pending_reg && io.cancel_pending.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This bug is a miss-admission and replay-control error in an L2 cache scheduler. A cache miss lookup should only be accepted when the downstream structures that record or service that miss can also accept the result, and a pending miss entry should only be replayed when an explicit cancel or dependency-clear event occurs. If those guards are too weak, the design can consume a lookup result without recording it, or reissue a pending MSHR at the wrong time, leading to lost requests, duplicate work, or stalls.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache miss admission, bookkeeping enqueue, and pending replay control
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A miss path allocates a new MSHR or interacts with a pending merged request while request-queue, directory, or dependency resources are back-pressured.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Relax the scheduler guards so a miss lookup can proceed without downstream bookkeeping readiness, and restore replay logic that reasserts a pending entry without requiring an explicit cancel event.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop handshake guards and restore stale replay predicate
portability_notes: Look for the point where a miss lookup result is both accepted from the directory and inserted into a miss-tracking structure or side queue.
The critical bug pattern is accepting work based on partial readiness, not full end-to-end readiness.
If the design has replayable pending miss entries, target the predicate that turns a canceled or blocked entry back into a schedulable request.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the control that issues directory or tag lookups for incoming cache requests.
Remove at least one downstream readiness guard so lookup acceptance no longer depends on miss bookkeeping queue readiness or MSHR availability.
Restore the enqueue condition so only merge cases, not fresh allocations, create the downstream request record, or equivalently suppress request-record creation on new alloc.
Change the pending-entry replay predicate so replay is re-enabled when pending is simply false rather than only on an explicit cancel or dependency-clear event.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scheduler miss admission and requests push gating, plus MSHR sche_a_valid replay control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes new allocations push into requests.io, gates directory.io.read.valid on miss-resource readiness and stall conditions, and changes MSHR sche_a_valid so pending entries re-arm only when io.cancel_pending is asserted.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In Scheduler, revert requests.io.push.valid and directory.io.read.valid to their looser forms; in MSHR, change the sche_a_valid re-arm condition back from pending_reg && io.cancel_pending to !pending_reg.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Miss requests can be accepted without complete bookkeeping, causing lost or duplicated miss state, incorrect replay of pending transactions, and eventual hangs or data corruption in the L2 pipeline.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, directory.io.read.valid ignored mshr_free, requests.io.push.ready, directory.io.ready, and mshr_stalls.
Before the fix, requests.io.push.valid only fired on merge_subentry, so a fresh allocation path could accept a miss result without recording it in the requests structure.
Before the fix, MSHR replay was re-enabled whenever pending_reg became false, not specifically when io.cancel_pending fired.
notes: This commit contains several related scheduler-control fixes; the most faithful injection is to reverse the full patch.
A narrower but still meaningful mutation is to drop the directory-read readiness guard while keeping the rest of the scheduler intact.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了多个相互耦合的 L2 scheduler/MSHR 控制缺陷：miss 查找只有在下游记账资源可接收时才发起，新分配的 miss 会建立请求队列项，而 pending MSHR 只会在显式 cancel 事件后重新调度。
why_it_counts: 所有改动都位于核心 L2 DUT 模块中，且每一处修改都直接影响 cache 控制行为。
补丁修复的是 miss 准入、miss 记账和 replay 条件，而不是格式或工具链问题。
若这些条件过弱，系统可能丢失 miss 状态、过早发起目录操作，或错误重放请求。
disqualifiers: 提交信息比较泛，还提到了 syntax，因此其意图没有其他条目那样直接。
evidence: Scheduler.scala 把 requests.io.push.valid 从 merge_subentry 改成 merge_subentry || alloc，使新分配的 miss 也会进入请求结构。
Scheduler.scala 用 mshr_free、requests.io.push.ready、directory.io.ready 和 mshr_stalls 等条件收紧了 directory.io.read.valid，而不是对所有非 Hint 请求都立即发起查找。
MSHR.scala 把 sche_a_valid 的重新置位条件从 !pending_reg 改成 pending_reg && io.cancel_pending。
没有修改任何非 DUT 文件。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这是一个 L2 cache scheduler 中的 miss 准入与 replay 控制错误。一个 cache miss 查找只有在下游记录或服务该 miss 的结构也能同时接收结果时，才应该被接受；而一个 pending miss 项也只应在显式 cancel 或依赖解除事件发生后才重新发射。如果这些保护条件过弱，设计就可能在没有正确记账的情况下吞掉一个查找结果，或者在错误时机重新发射 pending MSHR，最终导致请求丢失、重复处理或死锁。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: cache miss 准入、记账入队与 pending replay 控制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: miss 路径分配新 MSHR，或者 pending 合并请求在请求队列、目录或依赖资源背压时被处理。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 放松 scheduler 保护条件，使 miss 查找在下游记账资源未就绪时也能前进，并恢复一种无需显式 cancel 事件就会重新发射 pending 项的 replay 逻辑。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除握手保护并恢复陈旧 replay 谓词
portability_notes: 寻找一个 miss 查找结果既会从目录侧被接受、又会写入 miss 跟踪结构或辅助队列的位置。
关键错误模式是基于局部就绪而非端到端完整就绪来接受工作。
如果设计中存在可重放的 pending miss 项，应锁定那个将 canceled 或 blocked 项重新变成可调度请求的谓词。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位为进入中的 cache 请求发起 directory/tag lookup 的控制点。
删除至少一个下游就绪保护条件，使 lookup 接受不再依赖 miss bookkeeping 队列就绪或 MSHR 可用。
恢复旧的入队条件，使只有 merge 情况、而不是新分配情况会创建下游请求记录，或者等价地抑制新 alloc 的请求记录建立。
把 pending 项的 replay 条件改回“只要 pending 为 false 就重新允许调度”，而不是必须等显式 cancel 或依赖解除事件。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Scheduler 中的 miss 准入与 requests push 门控，以及 MSHR 的 sche_a_valid replay 控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复让新分配的 miss 也会写入 requests.io，要求 directory.io.read.valid 受 miss 资源就绪与冲突条件门控，并让 MSHR 的 sche_a_valid 只在 io.cancel_pending 断言时重新置位。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 Scheduler 中恢复较宽松的 requests.io.push.valid 与 directory.io.read.valid；在 MSHR 中把 sche_a_valid 的重置位条件从 pending_reg && io.cancel_pending 改回 !pending_reg。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: miss 请求可能在未完成完整记账时就被接受，导致 miss 状态丢失或重复，同时 pending 事务也可能被错误重放，最终在 L2 流水中表现为死锁、停顿或数据损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前，directory.io.read.valid 不依赖 mshr_free、requests.io.push.ready、directory.io.ready 或 mshr_stalls。
修复前，requests.io.push.valid 只在 merge_subentry 情况下触发，因此 fresh allocation 路径可能会接收 miss 结果却不建立 requests 记录。
修复前，MSHR replay 在 pending_reg 变为 false 时就会重新允许，而不是特定依赖 io.cancel_pending。
notes: 该提交同时修复了几个相关的 scheduler 控制问题；若要最忠实地复现原始缺陷，应整体逆转补丁。
若需要更窄的注入，单独去掉 directory-read 的就绪保护也能得到一个有代表性的 bug。
